# `adt aunit`

Run ABAP Unit tests

```bash
adt aunit [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                        | Description                                                                            | Default   |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-p, --package <package>`     | Run tests on package                                                                   |           |
| `-o, --object <uri>`          | Run tests on specific object (e.g., /sap/bc/adt/oo/classes/zcl_my_class)               |           |
| `-c, --class <name>`          | Run tests on ABAP class (e.g., ZCL_MY_CLASS)                                           |           |
| `-t, --transport <transport>` | Run tests on transport request (e.g., NPLK900042)                                      |           |
| `-f, --from-file <file>`      | Run tests on objects listed in file (one URI per line)                                 |           |
| `--format <format>`           | Output format: console, json, junit, sonar                                             | `console` |
| `--output <file>`             | Output file (required for junit/sonar format, e.g., aunit-report.xml)                  |           |
| `--coverage`                  | Request ABAP code coverage with the test run and follow the resulting measurement link |           |
| `--coverage-output <file>`    | Write the coverage report to this file (default: stdout for jacoco/sonar-generic)      |           |
| `--coverage-format <format>`  | Coverage format: jacoco \| sonar-generic                                               | `jacoco`  |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
